source_row.english: That experienced by consciousness Of eye, of ear, the thought, and by the three Represents respectively what's seen, What's heard, what's known, and also what is sensed.

spans.rationale: Exact eye noun. Exclude the repeated English relation Of.
Exact short source form RNA has glossary ear; do not silently expand it to RNA BA.
The mental faculty is explicitly thought in the glossary and in the nearby prose explanation356; exclude the.
Established consciousness compound. It governs the coordinated eye/ear/thought faculties; no internal lexical member fits inside the single English word.
First coordinator joins the first consciousness group to the remaining three faculties, owning and before the second by.
Exact number of remaining faculties, explained as nose/tongue/body in complete context356. Exclude the.
Established experiential compound with exact glossary experienced; no isolated SU or MYONG mapping is forced.
Whole relative-correlative frame GANG DE identifies what is experienced and is compressed to the opening That. Keep the phrase whole rather than declaring either part absent.
First of the four explicit experience labels; exclude the relative/copular frame.
Second label is directly heard; capitalization belongs to the adjacent supplied relative word, not this source noun.
Whole technical cognition expression is known in this fourfold list; distinguish the earlier RNAM SHES/consciousness noun. Complete glossary and prose356 establish the local order.
Second coordinator joins the last two experience labels. Tighten to and, leaving also as reinforcement.
Fourth label is exactly sensed in the complete glossary and local356 explanation. Do not swap it with the preceding known.
Established order expression is exactly respectively. It links the two fourfold lists without changing the source order.

omissions.english: Of; of; first by; second by
omissions.reason: The genitive and instrumental scope over coordinated groups, while English repeats of and by. No unique one-to-one ownership is secure; omission avoids arbitrary repeated-target selection and does not imply absence.

The copula and naming/explanation predicate jointly support the English classification. BSHAD has a broad represents glossary candidate, but I cannot isolate it confidently from the YIN construction here. Leave both unbanked without a null.

omissions.english: the; what's; What's; what is; also
omissions.reason: Articles, relative/copular frames and additive reinforcement remain outside the stated lexical claims. No English words are silently removed or supplied.
